# opnsense_ipsec_key_pair (Resource)

IPsec raw public key pairs (VPN > IPsec > Key Pairs), for public-key authentication without certificates. Generate the keys with the `tls_private_key` resource, for example.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tls_private_key" "ipsec" {
  algorithm   = "ECDSA"
  ecdsa_curve = "P256"
}

resource "opnsense_ipsec_key_pair" "local" {
  name        = "site-a"
  key_type    = "ecdsa"
  public_key  = tls_private_key.ipsec.public_key_pem
  private_key = tls_private_key.ipsec.private_key_pem_pkcs8
}

# The peer's public key only.
resource "opnsense_ipsec_key_pair" "peer" {
  name       = "site-b"
  key_type   = "ecdsa"
  public_key = file("site-b.pub.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_type` (String) Select the type of the key pair. One of `rsa` or `ecdsa`; must match the keys.
- `name` (String) Enter a name for this key pair. The name should help you to identify this key pair.
- `public_key` (String) Paste a public key of the selected type in X.509 format. Must be pasted including the `-----BEGIN ...-----` and `-----END [...]-----` headers.

### Optional

- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Paste an optional private key of the selected type in X.509 format which belongs to the public key specified above. When adding the public key of a peer, this field should not be specified as the private key remains solely with the peer. Must be pasted including the `-----BEGIN ...-----` and `-----END [...]-----` headers. Use PKCS#8 (`-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----`). Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the key pair.
- `key_fingerprint` (String) Key fingerprint, computed by OPNsense.
- `key_size` (String) Key size in bits, computed by OPNsense.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_ipsec_key_pair.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
